card.title: How To Turn On iPhone 14 to 16 Plus lower layer

source.title: How To Turn On iPhone 14 to 16 Plus lower layer

symptoms: need to test lower board alone

claims.statement: On iPhone 14–16 base/Plus the CPU is on the lower layer; after clearing a short on a split board you can boot the lower board alone by feeding 4.2 V into VDD_MAIN/VDD_BATT and briefly shorting the power button pin on the interposer connector to ground.

procedure: Connect DCPS 4.2 V to VDD_MAIN/VDD_BATT on lower board and ground.
Short the interposer power-button pin to ground with tweezers.
Watch DCPS draw for a full boot.
card.caveats: Power button pin location is shown only in images. Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
